note: Predeclared before any plan is benchmarked. A plan qualifies only if every applicable constraint is 'evaluated' and satisfied (or 'not_applicable' where allowed). Missing, unsupported or failed tests never count as satisfied. Change only with a new version id; select_targets records the version in every target.

constraints.description: No direct identifier survives in the output
No hard-label span (national id, email, phone, IBAN, card, secret, ...) leaks in free text
Linkage attack re-identification rate at or below the trust-level threshold
Every utility task the scenario requires is answerable on the protected output (status evaluated)

ranking.description: Among qualifying plans, rank by the mean utility score over the scenario's required utility tasks (higher is better); ties broken by fewer removed units, then by planHash.
